fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner present; the arbiter answered the planner's questions. Investigation: plan run 01M6W7G5J0M6 failed at step rebase (2026-11-08 00:20:00-00:20:32Z) when ship's head build (go build -o ... ./cmd/rhiza, internal/api/ship_build.go) lost its $WORK folder under TMPDIR=~/tmp mid-build ('open $WORK/bNNN/_pkg_.a: no such file or directory' across std packages). Ruled out: the daemon's gosweep removes only go-build* folders whose top-level mtime is over 2h old, and this one lived 32s; the daemon journal shows no sweep line and no re-exec in that window (re-execs at 23:58:46 and 00:24:55); tmpsweep and the budget TestMains remove only their own rhiza-* prefixes; testscripts give the daemon their own TMPDIR and GOCACHE, and Go unit-test clocks sit in the past, so their sweeps remove nothing real; no cron, user timer or tmpfiles rule covers ~/tmp; no agent transcript in the window removed go-build folders. The deleter stays unknown. Arbiter's ruling (Decision go-work-vanish-fix-shape): serve milestone-29; stop it by isolation: every process a run starts gets GOTMPDIR set to <git common dir>/rhiza/runs/<run id>/gotmp, created when a step starts and removed when the run ends, with gosweep unchanged; the retry lives in stepRunner.Command (internal/api/run.go): a command step that exits non-zero with go's vanished-$WORK signature is rerun once, with one stderr line, and the second result stands; the signature match is a small pure function with unit tests, and the engine stays language-agnostic.
fields.title: Plan interview: Fix A Go build inside a run (autonomous)
